verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an inference platform, but the evidence describes only a managed service: Baseten provisions the GPUs through MCM, runs the workloads, and deploys to its own infrastructure. The open-source Truss library packages model servers, but the evidence shows it as a tool for pushing models to Baseten, not a self-hostable copy of the platform. No evidence of an on-prem, self-hosted, or bring-your-own-cloud deployment of the core product.
